title: player: global console.log/warn monkeypatch can nest/leak with two concurrent RufflePlayer instances
description: FIXED: console monkeypatch leak with concurrent RufflePlayers. Replaced per-instance console.log/warn swap (RufflePlayer.tsx) with a ref-counted module-level interceptor (packages/player/src/consoleIntercept.ts installConsoleSink): pristine console captured once on first sink, restored once on last sink, single shared wrapper fans out to all sinks; defensive restore only if we still own the binding. RufflePlayer registers one sink per instance and removes it on unmount. Verify: full ordered build 'pnpm --filter ./packages/** build' EXIT=0; 'pnpm --filter @flash/player test' 27 passed (3 files) incl. consoleIntercept.test.ts (8 tests) with the interleaved-unmount regression case. docs/34-live-preview.md updated.
